atoms.sound: Droov’s shoes are old and have become uncomfortable, so he decides to go to the shopping centre to buy a new pair of trainers. As he’s walking past the different shops, he sees a large poster in the window of a shoe shop.

trainers.instruction: Where on the poster are customers told about the price of trainers? Choose.

atoms.a: What does 30% off most likely mean?
b: 30% of the shoes have lower prices.

atoms.sound: Hey, how are you. How can I help you?

Hi! I’m looking for new shoes. I walk a lot every day, so I need something comfortable. My old shoes are not waterproof, and my feet get wet when it rains, so I want waterproof shoes this time. I usually wear size 10s.

trainers.instruction: Choose all the things Dhruv wants from his shoes.

atoms.sound: These boots could be a good option. They are strong, fully waterproof and very comfortable. They are great for walking in bad weather. They cost £90. The 30% discount only applies to trainers, so these boots are not on sale.
They look nice, and I like that they are waterproof, but I think I forgot to say that I’m looking for trainers. I want something lighter and more flexible for everyday use.

atoms.a: Why does Dhruv not want the boots?
atoms.sound: Why does Droov not want the boots?
b: They are too expensive and not on sale.
++They are too heavy for everyday use.
They are the wrong size and colour.

atoms.sound: Let me show you two different pairs of trainers that are fully waterproof. The first pair is lighter and more flexible. They cost £45 with the 30% discount. They are the cheapest waterproof trainers in the shop, and we only have one pair left in your size.

The second pair is slightly heavier, but also very comfortable and better for long walks. This pair is more expensive and costs £70 with the discount. Here are both pairs in your size. You can try them on and see which one feels better.

atoms.a: What do the words cheap and expensive describe?

trainers.layout:
a1 b1 
a2 b2 
a3 b3

atoms.b: These shoes are ((cheap ++cheaper cheapest)) than the other ones.
They’re the ((cheap cheaper ++cheapest)) waterproof shoes in the shop.
These are ((expensive ++more_expensive most_expensive)) than the other ones.

atoms.sound: They both feel very comfortable, and the price difference is small. The first pair feels good, but I don’t really like the bright colour. The darker pair feels just as comfortable, and I prefer how they look. Since I will wear them every day, I want a colour that matches most of my clothes, so I think I’ll take these.
